candidates.task: Implement the bounded Authentication Session Revocation Orchestration Foundation
include: compose provider-neutral revocation triggers for password reset, account disablement, and material privilege reduction with the published browser-session boundary
preserve fail-closed immutable secret-free audit evidence and add focused deterministic tests
add bounded traceability to the already approved session-revocation requirements without extending policy
exclude: public API or UI, cookie transport, MFA or credential mutation, recovery execution, bootstrap, production operations, canonical changes, and policy invention

candidates.task: Implement the bounded Initial Owner Bootstrap Closure Guard Foundation
include: implement a provider-neutral transactional guard that permits initial-Owner bootstrap only while no Owner exists and permanently rejects repeated or additional-Owner bootstrap
preserve immutable secret-free audit evidence for permitted and rejected guard decisions with focused deterministic tests
add bounded traceability to the approved bootstrap-closure requirements without implementing production secret input or deployment operations
exclude: production CLI wiring, passwords, MFA or recovery-code generation or enrollment, public API or UI, account persistence beyond the guard boundary, production deployment, credentials, remote access, canonical changes, and policy invention
